messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Unusual auth replay detected. 3rd-party IPs repeatedly exchanging ephemeral tokens for service_account=ingest-worker. Sample token snippet: `eyJhbGci...` link: https://internal/alerts/8161234567

sarah: oncall pinged -> @miguel you're it this shift, can you take?

miguel: ack. joining bridge now. setting bridge: https://goto.redwood/bridge/8161234567

jess: any customer errors? I see an uptick in 401->200 retries in the proxy metrics dashboard.

miguel: early hypothesis: debug forwarder process was pointed at an external S3-like endpoint. It may have pushed logs containing ephemeral creds.

leah: if that's true, we need scoped rotation + scoping of exposed objects. Legal: FYI, hold customer comms until we know scope.

miguel: triage checklist (quick):
- isolate forwarder (stop process + block egress to suspect endpoint)
- rotate the ephemeral service token used by ingest-worker
- locate and remove any uploaded artifacts (put objects into quarantine bucket)
- audit access logs for exfil timeline
- run customer impact query (which tenants had requests during window)

ryan: I'll take rotation. Proposed commands:```bash
# create a new ephemeral token for ingest-worker
./infractl service-token create --service ingest-worker --ttl 1h --scope write
# update secrets (k8s/ssm/secretstore)
./infractl secret put --name /services/ingest-worker/token --value $NEW_TOKEN
# kill existing pods to pick up token
kubectl -n ingest rollout restart deploy/ingest-forwarder
```

miguel: good. ryan pls hold old token revocation until we verify there isn't a downstream job still using it. we'll revoke at T+10m after kill.

jess: I'll run the customer impact query: `SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM proxy_requests WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18T10:12Z' AND '2026-03-18T10:28Z' AND service='ingest' GROUP BY tenant_id;`

leah: security note: tag any removed objects with `exposed=true` and move to quarantine bucket with restricted ACLs. preserve originals for forensics.

miguel: found 2 objects in external bucket with names matching `ingest-debug-logs-*.gz`. Downloading manifest now.

ops-bot: automatic note: ticket created RF-8161, severity=high, pager duty escalation sent.

ryan: new token created and injected, restarting pods now. old token still valid for 10m window.

miguel: blocked egress to the external endpoint in the egress ACLs (az-eu-1). Confirmed no further writes from forwarder.

jess: customer impact query results: 3 tenant_ids with write activity during window, one shows elevated retry loops but no data size deltas. attaching CSV: https://internal/results/8161234567.csv

leah: start timeline:
- 10:12Z alert first observed
- 10:13Z forwarder misconfig detected
- 10:16Z egress blocked, new token provisioned
- 10:20Z pods restarted, old token revoked at 10:26Z

miguel: forensic notes: access logs show 5 unique external IPs pulled the uploaded objects between 10:14-10:18Z. copying logs to secure-forensics.

ryan: old token revoked at 10:26Z. Confirmed no further auths using that token after 10:27Z.

leah: recommend next steps:
- Security to run malware scan on artifacts
- Legal to prepare potential customer notice draft (if PII exists)
- CS to be ready for inbound tickets for tenants A,B,C
- Infra to add validation to forwarder config (block public endpoints by default)

miguel: mitigation complete for now. I'll document full RCA and post a follow-up in #postmortems. Leaving bridge in 30min for handoff to oncall rotation.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident RF-8161 status: mitigated -> monitoring. If new anomalies within 24h, auto-escalate.

sarah: thanks team. please add any artifacts to RF-8161 before leaving shift. I'll coordinate a follow-up timeline and customer-impact summary.

leah: noted, will start drafting legal/comm template.

miguel: leaving bridge. handing to next oncall. //miguel out
